student_id.description: A laminated pub receipt cosplaying as academic credentials. Honored as identification exactly nowhere. All three say 22.

aa_prize_paraffin_pucker.description: Red wax lips that taste like a birthday candle somebody else blew out. Lord Pilsner wore them for a full lap of the bar and logged every turned cheek as "a near miss."

aa_prize_fangs_for_nothing.effect: Cosmetic: while equipped, the wearer's battle shouts are lisped ("Thmaaaash!"). No stats.
aa_prize_fangs_for_nothing.description: Glow-in-the-dark vampire teeth one size too large for any human jaw. Bradley has worn them through two drinks and a pickup line and describes the night as "dangerous."

aa_prize_sixty_minute_emerald.effect: Cosmetic status Jade Knuckle after 60 in-game minutes worn. No stat change. Chadwick cites it as proof of authenticity in dialogue.
aa_prize_sixty_minute_emerald.description: A gold-tone ring with a green glass stone the size of a cocktail olive. After an hour the finger underneath matches the stone, which Chadwick says is how you know it's real.

aa_prize_five_finger_lint_discount.description: A sticky rubber hand on a three-foot leash, already furred with bar-floor hair, a ticket stub and one curly hair nobody will claim. Bradley slaps it on the bar whenever he wants another round and calls this "ordering."

aa_prize_pinky_promise_prison.description: A woven paper tube that tightens the harder you pull. Chadwick and Bradley got their fingers stuck in opposite ends and have been asking the bartender for the couples' discount.

aa_prize_neon_wrist_guillotine.description: A strip of spring steel in a hot-pink fabric sleeve that snaps around the wrist on impact and through the sleeve by Thursday. Bradley stacks it under his other bracelets and calls the set his "armor."

aa_prize_fuchsia_foot_of_fortune.description: A rabbit's foot dyed a pink no living rabbit ever reached, on a keychain that clearly did nothing for the rabbit. Chadwick clipped it to his chain wallet and rubs it before every claw-machine attempt.

aa_prize_sobriety_test_deluxe.effect: Usable from inventory. Always fails while the user is Drunk or Confused (tilt rattle, no result). Solvable sober, for no reward.
aa_prize_sobriety_test_deluxe.description: A palm-sized plastic maze with three silver balls and one hole, unsolvable after the second absinthe. Lord Pilsner has been working on it since eleven and says he is "one tilt away."

aa_prize_sit_down_comedy_special.effect: Battle item, once per battle, never consumed: 35% chance to inflict Embarrassed on one enemy. On a miss, the bros claim it hit.
aa_prize_sit_down_comedy_special.description: A pink rubber whoopee cushion priced like a used scooter. Bradley calls it "the strongest weapon in the building" and has deployed it on every bar stool, including the bidet.

aa_prize_flamingo_hydro_bro_2000.effect: Field interaction: squirt an NPC for a one-line reaction. No battle use.
aa_prize_flamingo_hydro_bro_2000.description: A flamingo-pink pump-action squirt gun that holds one shot glass of liquid and leaks a second. Chadwick filled it with absinthe and calls it his "concealed carry."

aa_prize_highlighter_hydro_bro_2000.effect: Field interaction: squirt an NPC for a one-line reaction. No battle use.
aa_prize_highlighter_hydro_bro_2000.description: The same squirt gun in highlighter yellow, won separately because Lord Pilsner refused to share a weapons platform with Chadwick. It holds beer. It does not hold it well.

aa_prize_two_grand_tie_dye_tee.description: A one-size-fits-nobody tie-dye shirt printed slightly crooked with I ♥ ABSINTHE ARCADE. Bradley wears it over his jersey and calls it his "championship belt."

aa_prize_chuck_e_cheese_plush.description: A cross-eyed plush pizza rat in a chef's hat, stuffed with what feels like aquarium gravel and smelling like a ball pit. Lord Pilsner handed over two and a half thousand tickets for it and calls it "the crown jewels."

aa_claw_pre_emptive_perry.description: A camo bear whose plastic pellets feel suspiciously like depleted uranium.

poem: Perry searches near and far,
For hidden weapons in the jar.
He found no yellowcake today,
So now in Europe he will stay!

aa_claw_pets_con_sock_hound.description: A plush sock puppet whose IPO valuation dropped ninety-eight percent before the stuffing settled.

poem: Super Bowl ads cost a lot,
Now an empty parking lot.
Hug this dog with all your might,
His burn rate peaked on Tuesday night!

aa_claw_snorty_bouncer_badger.description: His snout has a permanent crust of baby laxative and unresolved nightclub hostility.

poem: Snorty grinds his plushy jaws,
White residue on velvet paws.
Keep him away from bathroom stalls,
He’s pacing up and down the walls!

aa_claw_mugshot_mandy.description: A Chihuahua whose rhinestone collar carries two active bench warrants and a sticky smear of lip gloss.

poem: Low-rise velour, no underwear,
Flashbulbs blinding in the air.
Lost her license, kept the fame,
Nobody can pronounce her name!

aa_claw_minty_rare_mint_bunny.description: Still trapped in a yellowed acrylic display cube with a sun-bleached Certificate of Authenticity.

poem: Keep my plastic tag attached,
A fortune waiting to be hatched.
Divorce courts had to split my fleece,
Three thousand SOVS for one piece!

aa_junk_terminal_velocity_terry.description: A tangled tangle of green plastic that promises high-altitude heroism and delivers a direct face-plant into bar slop.

aa_junk_forty_eight_hour_tramp_stamp.description: A sheet of barbed-wire tribal designs applied with warm beer and removed by twenty minutes of aggressive sweating.

aa_junk_noise_violation.description: Neon-orange molded plastic without a pea. It produces a shrill, piercing squeal calibrated to trigger immediate bar-staff homicide.
